title: fix(docs): correct five generated API request examples
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Corrected five curated request bodies used to generate API docs curl examples. Messages now includes `model` and `max_tokens`; Decisions includes a `questions` object. Community-model registration adds a title, and model registration, endpoint testing, and endpoint-agent registration replace obsolete `baseUrl` fields with `api` and exact `url` fields. The generated examples now match the current request schemas; this PR does not regenerate the tracked `APIDOCS.md`.
